newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Samsung says Fokker takeover can't go wrong - agency.
newsitem.headline: Samsung says Fokker takeover can't go wrong - agency.

text.p: A takeover of Dutch plane maker Fokker by South Korea's Samsung is now just a question of time, according to a Samsung spokesman, Dutch news agency ANP said on Friday.
"The deal can't go wrong any more. The only thing to be decided is when it will be announced by Samsung," the agency quoted the spokesman as saying.

The spokesman was reacting to an article in a South Korean newspaper reporting that a definite price had been agreed and the agreement was only being held up by the need for approval from the two governments.
The spokesman declined to confirm the acquisition price quoted by the Korean paper of 253.5 million guilders ($150 million).
